Orbital — Technical Writer (Knowledge Manager)

  • Redesigned the ReadMe site to match current Orbital branding and unified 3 separate products into one docs site
  • Migrated 40+ API endpoints from Postman into ReadMe, replacing a fragmented two-platform setup with a single source of truth
  • Created 75+ new knowledge base pages and defined the information architecture
  • Built onboarding checklists and task-based flows using ReadMe Recipes for merchant payment integration workflows
  • Used Claude Code and Gemini to speed up drafting and PR reviews, reducing review-readiness by an average of 3 days
  • Created markdown instruction files for Claude (skills.md, agents.md, prompts.md) and connected MCP servers for AI-assisted documentation
  • Set up CI/CD pipelines with automated linters, format checks, link checks, and spell checks. Configured GitHub Actions to sync the OpenAPI spec with ReadMe
  • Presented a documentation roadmap to product leadership and set up Jira-based planning
  • Tracked page views, search queries, and drop-off rates using ReadMe and Google Analytics
